description: This file is a Perl module that provides functions and mechanisms for running, controlling, and coordinating tests within a testing framework for the curl project. It manages IPC communication, test environment setup, server control, test execution, and post-test cleanup, especially tailored for complex test scenarios involving subprocess management and debugging tools.

methods.name: runner_init
methods.description: Initializes the test runner, sets up communication pipes, possibly forks a process for multiplexed test execution, and prepares directory structures.

methods.name: event_loop
methods.description: Runs the IPC event loop, processing incoming calls until a shutdown signal is received.

methods.name: checktestcmd
methods.description: Checks if a command exists in the system PATH, considering specific directory paths.

methods.name: use_valgrind
methods.description: Determines whether Valgrind should be used based on configuration.

methods.name: normalize_cmdres
methods.description: Converts the raw command return code into a standardized form, considering signals and core dumps.

methods.name: prepro
methods.description: Processes test scripts to replace variables, handle conditionals, and prepare test data.

methods.name: readtestkeywords
methods.description: Loads test-specific keywords into a hash for later use during test execution.

methods.name: logslocked
methods.description: Returns a list of current log lock files to detect ongoing server log writes.

methods.name: torture
methods.description: Performs memory allocation failure testing by deliberately failing allocations during test runs.

methods.name: restore_test_env
methods.description: Restores environment variables to their saved states post-test.

methods.name: singletest_startservers
methods.description: Starts the necessary servers for a particular test case, handling setup and verification.

methods.name: singletest_preprocess
methods.description: Prepares and saves a preprocessed version of the test script with variable replacements.

methods.name: singletest_setenv
methods.description: Sets environment variables as specified in the test script.

methods.name: singletest_precheck
methods.description: Checks whether the test environment is suitable for executing the test, e.g., availability of required commands.

methods.name: singletest_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the testing environment, including cleanup and setup of required files.

methods.name: singletest_run
methods.description: Executes the test command, setting up environment, handling debugging tools, and capturing outputs.

methods.name: singletest_clean
methods.description: Performs cleanup after test execution, checks for core dumps, and manages server log lock files.

methods.name: singletest_postcheck
methods.description: Runs post-test verification commands to ensure test success.

methods.name: runner_test_preprocess
methods.description: Prepares test environment, including server startup, environment variable setup, and test script preprocessing.

methods.name: runner_test_run
methods.description: Runs a full test, including setup, execution, cleanup, and verification, using the other internal functions.

methods.name: runnerac_clearlocks
methods.description: Asynchronous call to clear log locks on servers.

methods.name: runnerac_shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the runner process; closes communication channels.

methods.name: runnerac_stopservers
methods.description: Asynchronous call to stop server processes.

methods.name: runnerac_test_preprocess
methods.description: Asynchronous call to preprocess test scripts.

methods.name: runnerac_test_run
methods.description: Asynchronous call to run a full test.

methods.name: controlleripccall
methods.description: Sends an IPC call to the runner to invoke a specified function with arguments.

methods.name: runnerar
methods.description: Receives and decodes an asynchronous response from the runner.

methods.name: runnerar_ready
methods.description: Checks if a runner has an IPC response ready or if there was an error.

methods.name: runnerabort
methods.description: Cleanly aborts the runner, shutting down servers and cleaning up.

methods.name: ipcrecv
methods.description: Reads an IPC command from the runner pipe, executes the corresponding function, and sends back the result.

methods.name: runner_clearlocks
methods.description: Kills server processes that are holding log lock files.

methods.name: runner_stopservers
methods.description: Terminates all server processes.

methods.name: runner_shutdown
methods.description: Performs cleanup and terminates the runner process.
